company_profile: Mastercard runs a global payments network, and its AI Centre of Excellence builds machine learning and foundation-model capabilities on large-scale transaction data.
title: Lead Data Scientist, AI Engineering
summary: Senior Data Scientist with 8+ years taking machine learning projects from problem definition to production across Healthcare, Telecom and AIOps. Builds predictive models for forecasting, propensity, recommendation ranking and anomaly detection with XGBoost, LightGBM, Scikit-learn and PyTorch, and applies transformer embeddings to improve downstream models. Defines evaluation approaches, works in Python, SQL, Databricks and Spark, and turns results into clear recommendations for stakeholders. Alongside this, I am building ThinkTree.AI, a non-profit AI learning platform used by NGO teachers to support students with ADHD.

project.name: Transaction Embedding Propensity Models
bullets: Built customer propensity and churn models on card transaction sequences, learning transformer-based embeddings of spending behaviour in PyTorch and feeding them into LightGBM as reusable features.
Benchmarked embedding features against hand-crafted baselines using time-based splits and AUC comparisons, tracked runs in MLflow and ran batch scoring on Databricks with Spark.

paragraphs: I am applying for the Lead Data Scientist, AI Engineering role at Mastercard. Over eight years I have taken machine learning projects from a loose business question to a model in production, across propensity, forecasting, recommendation ranking and anomaly detection. What connects them is measuring impact honestly against what existed before.

Your AI Centre of Excellence is building reusable learned representations from transaction data so teams stop rebuilding features for every use case, and that shift is the work I want to be part of. My fiancée lives in Berlin, and we plan to move to Dublin together and settle there long term.

I would bring applied depth and a habit of guiding others. At Viavi I built an SLA breach prediction system with LightGBM and MLflow that reduced downtime by 67%, and an alarm clustering engine on Sentence-BERT embeddings that improved classification by 73.5%. Mentoring across 15+ client POCs taught me to lead through influence.

Outside work I am building ThinkTree.AI, a non-profit AI learning platform used by NGO teachers to support students with ADHD. It reminds me that a model is only as good as its effect on the people using it. I would be glad to talk about how I could help shape your team's work.
